parameters.subject: Welcome to INTINC Connect! 🎉

Welcome to INTINC Connect!

Hi {{$node['Validate & Enrich Data'].json.first_name}},

We're thrilled to welcome you to the INTINC family! 🌟

INTINC Connect is our employee engagement platform where you can:

  • 🎯 Give and receive recognition from teammates
  • 🎁 Earn points and redeem rewards
  • 📊 Participate in pulse surveys
  • 🏆 Join wellness challenges
  • 💬 Connect with your department and interest groups

You've been awarded 100 welcome points! Use them to send your first recognition or save them for rewards.

Get Started →

Your manager {{$node['Validate & Enrich Data'].json.manager_email}} has been notified and will reach out soon.

Welcome aboard! 🚀

The INTINC Team
